tooltip.arkofcosmos.old_one_attack:
Fires different homing projectiles based on what biome you're in
Upon hitting an enemy you are granted a buff based on what biome you're in
The physical culmination of your journey, capable of rending gods asunder
Empowered by the might of the Fourth Calamity, it has reclaimed the strength lost to the annals of history.
tooltip.arkofcosmos.controls:
<left> to perform a 5-swing combo that ends by throwing the blade
The thrown blade will follow your cursor
Releasing while the blade is out will cause an exploding snap
tooltip.arkofcosmos.parry:
<right> to snip out the scissor blades in front of you
Hitting an enemy with it will parry them
Parry can granting you brief invulnerability
Parrying anything will empower the next 16 swings of the sword
tooltip.arkofcosmos.blast:
With empowered charges, hold %1$s and press %2$s to provoke a Big Rip in spacetime, consuming all charges
If at least 5 charges were consumed, keep holding %1$s and %2$s until after the snap to dash toward the scissors
tooltip.arkofcosmos.flavor: The physical culmination of your journey, capable of rending gods asunder
galaxia.description.0:
Swing Galaxia around you, accelerating over time and emitting homing
cosmic bolts
Release when charged to hurl Galaxia toward your crosshair alongside six
gigantic cosmic bolts
galaxia.controls: Hold %1$s to attack; release to unleash a charged attack
galaxia.description.2:
Channel a vortex of galactic energies that grows stronger over time and
on enemy hits
Release when charged to fire the star forward; immediately attack toward
it again to dash to it and release cosmic bolts
galaxia.select: Choose an attunement; release %1$s to confirm
galaxia.description.3:
Charge a god-erasing lunge, emitting cosmic bolts as you charge; release
to unleash it
Terrain impact causes a shockwave and a storm of cosmic energies
spreading across the surface
galaxia.description.1:
Throw Galaxia toward your crosshair, tethered by constellations
The spinning blade follows your aim; hits cause nebulous explosions that
spawn homing cosmic bolts
galaxia.flavor:
Freed from earthly shackles and coursing with cosmic power
Has access to all attunements at all times
galaxia.passive.0:
Capricorn's Blessing: periodically releases weakening stars around your
crosshair while attacking
The ring initially moves away from you, slowing over time
galaxia.passive.1:
Cancer's Blessing: periodically releases lifestealing stars around you
while attacking
The ring initially moves toward you, slowing over time
galaxia.selection_controls:
Hold %1$s to open the selector
Move the cursor to an attunement; release to confirm
elements.combo: Hold %s to perform a 5-swing combo that ends by throwing the blade
elements.snap: Release at the right moment while the blade is out to snap shut and deal extra damage
elements.parry: %s to snip out the scissor blades in front of you and gain brief invulnerability
elements.parry_window: Hit an enemy or take an attack within 0.25 seconds of activation to parry
elements.empower: Parrying empowers the next 10 swings of the sword, letting you use both blades at once
elements.blast: With empowered charges, hold %s and press %s to provoke a Big Rip in spacetime and use all charges
elements.flavor: A heavenly pair of blades infused with the essence of §kTerraria§r, powerful enough to cut through the fabric of reality
boss.arkofcosmos.mahou.name: EverlaPrismer Aya
entity.arkofcosmos.mahou_tsukai.phase_2: God of the End   EverlaPrismer Aya
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.first_end: Strange. You should be dead by now...
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.second_rain: It has not been long since you barely defeated the Wither. That thing was a failure, was it not?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.phase_two_hal: You wield tremendous power, yet use it only for your own selfish desires.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.escape: Do not try to run. As long as you live, pain will never leave you.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.summon: A newcomer who knows only killing and stealing, yet gains power through it. Who does that remind me of...?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.summon_dead: The outcome of this battle means nothing to you! Then what reason do you have to interfere?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.low_quarter_2: If I fail here, I have no future.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.low_quarter_3: Once you defeat me, only one path remains.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.low_quarter_4: And that path... has no future either.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_2: You do not seem to be that fourth calamity...
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_3: Then, to apologize for mistaking you for someone else, take this.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_4: I took this from that one. It should be useful to you.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.first_rain_re: If you want to feel a democratic elbow, you found the right person.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.first_end_rep: If your soul is scattered one day, would you mind if I worked it into my spell?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.second_rain_r: You are still far from victory.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.third_rain_re: It has been a long time since I tested my magic on such an interesting target dummy.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.vortex_repeat: I wonder whether you have seen these in nightmares since our first encounter.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.summon_repeat: Only an empty shell in the form of a Guardian; perhaps some fragment of its soul remains.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_1_repe: An impressive performance. I acknowledge your victory.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_2_repe: Without a doubt, you will meet enemies far stronger than me.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_3_repe: I believe you will not make the same mistake she did.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_4_repe: I look forward to seeing what becomes of your future.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.low_quarter_r: At least your technique has not declined.
boss.arkofcosmos.the_player: 'I’m Angry When I‘m Angry', Kirara Official
boss.arkofcosmos.the_player.name: Kirara Official
boss.arkofcosmos.the_player.title: 'I’m Angry When I‘m Angry'
fractured.parry: %s to extend the Ark out in front of you
fractured.charge: Successfully parrying empowers the next 10 swings of the sword, boosting damage and letting them throw projectiles
fractured.window: Parrying grants a small window of invulnerability; hitting an enemy or blocking an attack during it counts as a successful parry
fractured.flavor: A worn down and rusty blade once wielded against the evil of this world, ready to be of use once more
ancients.flavor: A heavenly blade forged to vanquish all evil
ancients.blast: Hold %s and %s to release all empowered charges in a powerful burst of energy
true_biome.select: Hold %s: outer ring primary / inner ring secondary
true_biome.controls:
Hold %s to attack; release to unleash
Hold %s to open the attunement wheel; release to confirm
Outer ring: active attunement; inner ring: passive attunement
true_biome.attack.0:
Hold %s to swing the sword around you, accelerating over time
Sword beams are fired wildly while swinging
Releasing hurls the sword towards your cursor
Sword beams home onto enemies struck by the thrown sword
true_biome.attack.1:
Lash out with a flurry of chained blades
Striking enemies with the tip of the blades guarantees a critical hit
Critical strikes send out extra phantom chains which latch onto multiple targets
true_biome.attack.2:
Hold %s to conjure molten blades in front of you
The blades get larger and stronger the more you hit enemies
The blades can also be used to bounce off tiles when in the air
Releasing sends the charged blades hurtling forwards like a wheel
Attacking again immediately thereafter dashes to the wheel, shredding anything in the way
true_biome.attack.3:
Hold %s to charge a heaven-shattering lunge, release to unleash the devastating blow
Shock waves are emitted as the sword charges up
Striking the earth with the lunge will cause a massive shock wave on impact which raises a flood of monoliths
true_biome.passive.0: All attacks have a chance to fire sword beams
true_biome.passive.1:
An enchanted chain hook floats near you
Striking enemies makes the hook whirl around you, freezing enemies
true_biome.passive.2: Striking enemies rarely steals a small amount of life
true_biome.passive.3: Periodically emit shock waves while attacking
biome.attack.-1:
Does nothing... yet
Performs ordinary sword swings until attuned
biome.controls:
Hold %1$s to attack; release to unleash charged attacks
Hold %2$s to open the attunement wheel; point and release to confirm
Visit the matching environment to permanently unlock an attunement
biome.attack.0:
Fires a weak projectile that crushes enemy defenses
Landing true melee hits places a sigil of purity over the enemy
Your projectiles home onto the marked foes
biome.attack.1:
Hold %s to conjure searing blades in front of you
The blades get larger and stronger the more you hit enemies
The blades can also be used to bounce off blocks when in the air
Release with enough charge to send the blades hurtling forwards to shred your foes
biome.attack.2:
Perform a 3-strike combo with a glacial blade; the final strike briefly freezes foes
Lingering glacial mist is released while swinging, damaging enemies that enter it
biome.attack.3:
Throw out the blade using a vine whip
Striking enemies with the tip as the whip cracks guarantees a critical hit
The whip also propels you towards struck blocks
Spreading vines sprout from critical strikes and can hit up to three targets
biome.attack.4:
Lunge forward using a ghostly rapier projection
Striking foes leeches life and bounces you away from them
Landing three strikes without touching the ground empowers your next attack into a dash thrust
biome.attack.5:
Hold %s to swing the sword around you, accelerating over time
Release after charging long enough to hurl the sword towards your crosshair
The sword then quickly returns to your hand
biome.attack.6:
Hold %s to charge a star-piercing lunge; release after charging enough to unleash the devastating blow
Striking the earth causes a massive impact which raises otherworldly monoliths
biome.attack.7:
Shoot two water balls towards your crosshair
On ground contact they become small waves that ride along the ground
Waves fired underwater or touching water become larger, faster and stronger
Empowered waves dissipate when they leave water
broken_biome.attack.-1:
Does nothing... yet
Performs ordinary sword swings until attuned
broken_biome.attack.0: Fires a weak projectile that crushes enemy defenses
broken_biome.attack.1:
Hold %s to conjure searing blades in front of you
The blades get larger and stronger the more you hit enemies
The blades can also be used to bounce off blocks when in the air
broken_biome.attack.2:
Perform a 3-strike combo with a glacial blade
The final strike briefly freezes foes
broken_biome.attack.3:
Throw out the blade using a vine whip
Striking enemies with the tip as the whip cracks guarantees a critical hit
The whip also propels you towards struck blocks
broken_biome.attack.4:
Lunge forward using a ghostly rapier projection
The first hit leeches life and bounces you away from the target
Lunge once in midair; landing or bouncing with searing blades restores it
broken_biome.controls:
Hold %1$s to attack
Hold %2$s to open the attunement wheel; point and release to confirm
Visit the matching environment to permanently unlock an attunement
broken_biome.locked: Visit the corresponding environment to unlock
tooltip.arkofcosmos.auric_bar.summon: §cPlace in a beacon to summon the Fourth Calamity
tooltip.arkofcosmos.ashes_of_calamity.su: §cPlace in a beacon to summon the Supreme Mahou Tsukai
jei.arkofcosmos.ashes_of_calamity.source: Obtained by defeating a Wither infected by Calamity
jei.arkofcosmos.beacon_summoning.instruc: Insert 1 material and click the netherite sword to summon. No beacon level is required. The material is consumed.
tooltip.arkofcosmos.calamity_skull.summo: Can be used to summon a Wither infected by Calamity
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.rage_purple: Die die die die die die!!!!
dialogue.arkofcosmos.fourth.name: <Kirara>
dialogue.arkofcosmos.fourth.defeat: It hurts so much, it hurts so much!
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalSummo: Do you enjoy going through hell?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalBH2Te: It wasn't too long ago you barely managed to defeat my doppelganger. Quite the failure, wasn't it?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalBH3Te: You've harnessed great power, but you wield it for no one but yourself.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalBroth: Would you like to meet my family? Horrible, isn't it?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalBH4Te: It's absurd to even think of trying to get away. As long as you live, you will suffer.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalSeeke: An upstart who recklessly stole and killed their way to power. I wonder, who does that remind me of...?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalBH5Te: You have no stake in this battle. No one gave you any say in this matter!
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalSepul: Once the dust has settled and only one remains, if it is you, what value will this have had?!
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalDespa: I have no future if I lose here.
Once you have bested me, you will only have one path forward.
And that path... also has no future.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalAccep: Even if he has thrown all else away, his power remains.
I have no more energy left to resent him, or you...
It will all be in your hands now.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalSummo: If you're looking for some fourth-degree burns, you've got the right person.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalStart: When the time comes, would you like to join my creation?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalBH2Te: You'll still have to work hard for this victory.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalBH3Te: I haven't had such an interesting target dummy to test my magic on in a long time.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalBroth: Empty shells of their former selves. I doubt even a scrap of their spirits remain.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalBH4Te: I wonder if you've seen these in your nightmares since our first battle?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalSeeke: Your skill hasn't faltered in the least.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalSepul: Here comes the crawling tomb, one last time.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.calamitas.SCalDespa: A terrific display, I concede this match to you.
No doubt you will face enemies stronger than I.
I trust you will not make the same mistakes he did.
I can't imagine what your future holds now.
commands.projectc.calamitas.summon_faile: Failed to summon Supreme Evoker, Calamitas
boss.arkofcosmos.calamitas.name: Calamitas
boss.arkofcosmos.calamitas.title: Supreme Evoker
jei.arkofcosmos.annihilation_ember.sourc: Place one Ashes of Annihilation on each of four pedestals in a Goety Sabbath ritual and activate with a Netherite Ingot to summon Calamitas. Completing the battle drops 32-48 Ashes of Annihilation.
jei.arkofcosmos.satsuki_rin.summon: Place one Auric Bar on each of four pedestals in a Goety Sabbath ritual and activate with a Doom Medal (10 soul energy, 5 seconds). After the same summoning lead-up as the Apostle, Satsuki Rin appears. Defeating her always drops the First Fractal and the Bejeweled Staff, plus Enchanted Golden Apples, Apocalyptium Ingots, Dark Ingots, an Ascension Halo, a Heavy Core, Auric Bars, Ashes of Annihilation and a Dimensional Will.
curse.arkofcosmos.indignant.description: Summons demons that harm you but drop healing items on death on item usage.
curse.arkofcosmos.aflame.description: Ignites enemies with the Supreme Witch's power on hit but also causes the user to take damage over time when holding this item.
curse.arkofcosmos.oblatory.description: Reduces mana cost and greatly increases damage but sometimes causes this item to use your life.
curse.arkofcosmos.resentful.description: Makes the damage of projectiles vary based on how far the hit target is from you. The farther, the more damage, and vice versa.
curse.arkofcosmos.bloodthirsty.descripti: Makes the damage of projectiles vary based on how far the hit target is from you. The closer, the more damage, and vice versa.
curse.arkofcosmos.ephemeral.description:
Causes the damage output of this item to discharge from exhaustive use.
Its damage returns naturally when not being used. It starts off with more damage than it normally would have.
curse.arkofcosmos.hellbound.description:
Causes minions to be created with a 40 second timer.
Once it runs out, they explode violently. Minions do more damage the longer they live and idly explode as well.
curse.arkofcosmos.tainted.description: Removes projectile shooting capabilities of this item. In exchange, two skeletal arms are released on use that slice at the mouse position.
curse.arkofcosmos.traitorous.description: Using this item below 25% mana instantly consumes your remaining mana, unleashing a monster that harms both you and enemies.
curse.arkofcosmos.withering.description:
When hurt, you heal a percentage of the damage taken based on how much accumulated damage you did overall beforehand, up to 100%.
After this, you gain a damage boost while holding this item but also take exponential damage over time the longer you hold it.
curse.arkofcosmos.persecuted.description:
When attacked, or over time, demon portals appear near you.
If sufficiently damaged they are friendly; otherwise they attack you. They become angered if a portal is damaged.
curse.arkofcosmos.lecherous.description: Spawns a resilient brimstone monster that stays between you and your mouse that interferes with your homing weapons. It will recover your health on death.
item.arkofcosmos.rancor.description:
Casts a magic circle that charges energy and eventually releases a powerful laser burst of controlled maleficent magic
The laser causes arms and searing lava to appear on surfaces it touches
item.arkofcosmos.gruesome_eminence.descr:
Summons a gaseous conglomeration of spirits near the cursor that fly around wildly
Over time, the spirits accumulate to create a single, controllable monstrosity
menu.arkofcosmos.necromantic_infusion.de: Consumes 64 emeralds to create a new item. Input data is discarded. This conversion cannot be disenchanted.

advancements.arkofcosmos.brimstone_sea.d: Kill an ocean creature with Rancor
advancements.arkofcosmos.on_fire.title: I’m on Fire
advancements.arkofcosmos.on_fire.descrip: Apply the Aflame curse to a weapon
item.arkofcosmos.violence.flavor: A demonic pitchfork, cursed to cause endless bloodshed
item.arkofcosmos.violence.left: Hold %s to command the trident along your sight and shred enemies with devastating speed
item.arkofcosmos.violence.right: %s throws the trident, violently tearing through enemies and inflicting Vulnerability Hex for 4 seconds
item.arkofcosmos.violence.aflame: Aflame doubles the strength of the Vulnerability Hex inflicted by this weapon
config.arkofcosmos.rageUpdateInterval.co: How often (in ticks) to scan for hostile entities for rage charging. Lower = more accurate but worse performance. (1-20)
config.arkofcosmos.rageCacheDuration.com: How long (in ticks) to cache hostile entity scan results. Should be >= rageUpdateInterval for best performance.
config.arkofcosmos.rageDetectionRadius.c: Maximum distance to detect hostile entities for rage charging (8-64 blocks)
config.arkofcosmos.rageInnerRadius.comme: Distance for maximum rage charging speed (4-32 blocks, should be < rageDetectionRadius)
jei.arkofcosmos.witch.instructions: Speak to the Brimstone Witch to infuse the item.
item.arkofcosmos.bejeweled_staff.descrip: Draws upon the power of many gems
first_fractal.use: Hold %s to summon sword-wielding afterimages that intercept nearby enemies.
item.arkofcosmos.bejeweled_staff.control: Hold %s to fire three gems of one random color
